infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: apexVIP connects to your Polar H10 to record heart rate and RR intervals.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connect to your local apexVIP development server.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Record phone movement, cadence, steps and elevation during your workout.
